translations.text: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, to the church of God in Corinth, together with all the saints throughout Achaia.
Grace to you and peace from God our Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
But it is God who established us, together with [?], in Christ and anointed us.
So we are always confident and know that as long as we remain here in the body, we are away from the Lord.
Through glory and dishonor, praise and reproach; regarded as deceivers, yet truthful.
You are not constrained by us, but you are constrained in your own affections.

Now this very thing, that you grieved according to God's will—what diligence it produced in you, what appeals, what indignation, what fear, what longing, what zeal, what desire for justice! For in everything you showed yourselves to be innocent in this matter.
I do not say this as a command, but through the diligence of others I am testing the sincerity of your love.
For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ: though he was rich, he became poor for your sake, so that through his poverty you might become rich.
But now complete the deed itself, so that just as you were willing and eager, you may also carry it out according to what you have.
For I know your eagerness, about which I have boasted to the Macedonians, saying that the people of Achaia have been ready since last year; and your zeal has stirred up many.
Otherwise, if Macedonians come with us and find you unprepared, we—not to mention you—will be put to shame in this matter of boasting.
So I considered it necessary to urge the brothers to come to you beforehand and prepare in advance your previously promised gift, so that it would be ready as a blessing and not as an act of greed.
What I am doing I will continue to do, so that I may cut off the opportunity of those who want an opportunity to be found equal to us in what they boast about.
You readily put up with fools in your wisdom.
In Damascus, the governor under King Aretas was guarding the city of the Damascenes to seize me.
